Greetings!

Huge thanks to all you guys who left suggestions, especially Nelson; I'm currently working on implementing your amaz... your ideas! (jk). 

Anyway, I've added one of the more complex items:
THE MAGIC 8-BALL (Idea by Inkling9578)!
-Right click to gain THREE random effects for the next 30 seconds. Effects include: [ALL ~40 EFFECTS IN JAVA EDITION]
The item is avalible in the shop for 16 Diamonds, or you can craft it, so check your recipe book!
The item also has it's own advancement, so THERE. DAMN COMPLETIONISTS.

---Resource Pack Changes---
-Added texture for "Magic 8-Ball"
-Added textures for "Darts & Daggers" (Currently Functionality: None)

---Bug Fixes---
-Ghost mace with "/give" is no longer an issue
-Gunpowder dupe patched

---Known Bugs---
-Items randomly becoming Unbreakable
-Mace needs nerf

Thanks for reading, and good job to August for winning the mace!
